tools.name: convert_to_toman
tools.description: Converts a fiat, crypto, or gold amount to an estimated Toman value using latest Arzbin indicative market data. Not financial advice.

assetType.description: Asset type: fiat, crypto, or gold.

code.description: Asset code such as USD, EUR, USDT, BTC, EMAMI, or GOLD_GRAM.

amount.description: Amount of the asset to convert to Toman. Must be greater than zero.

tools.name: get_latest_gold_rates
tools.description: Returns latest Arzbin gold and coin rates in Toman. Data is indicative market data, not financial advice.

types.description: Optional gold or coin codes such as EMAMI, AZADI, GOLD_GRAM. Omit for all available gold rates.

tools.name: get_market_history
tools.description: Returns OHLC history for a fiat, gold, or crypto market. Days are clamped to 1-365.

assetType.description: Asset type: fiat, gold, or crypto.

code.description: Market code, such as USD, EMAMI, GOLD_GRAM, USDT, BTC.

days.description: Number of days of history to return, from 1 to 365.

tools.name: get_latest_crypto_rates
tools.description: Returns latest curated Arzbin crypto prices in Toman and USD. Data is indicative market data, not financial advice.

symbols.description: Optional crypto symbols such as USDT, BTC, ETH. Omit for all available crypto rates.

tools.name: get_latest_fiat_rates
tools.description: Returns latest Arzbin fiat currency rates in Toman. Data is indicative market data, not financial advice.

codes.description: Optional fiat currency codes such as USD, EUR, AED, GBP. Omit for all available fiat rates.

tools.name: get_fiat_rate_sources
tools.description: Returns Arzbin source comparison data for a fiat currency code where available.

code.description: Fiat currency code such as USD, EUR, AED, GBP.
